id: # The events during the game of the east map (docs/EUROPE.md, E7). The engine has one interpreter. Each row has a window and preconditions. No row has a fixed date.
# conditions: clauses separated by ";". A row starts when all clauses hold for one faction. effects: the changes, in order. chance: the percent for each month.
# The row names an officer by the English key, for example @baybars. The engine changes each key to the officer before the sim reads the row (E7).
# Clauses of E7: date_from:YYYY/MM, date_until:YYYY/MM, at_war:F:G, allied:F:G, owner:CITY:F|G|- (a dash is a city without an owner), church:latin|greek|armenian|muslim, after:KEY.

#   F and G are the ids of forces.tsv, and CITY is the id of cities.tsv. The other clauses are the clauses of the M9 events: rules:C|C, free:@i|@j, has:@i, ruler:@i, merit_at_least:@i:N, order_ruler_below:N.
# Effects of E7: seize:@i (the officer takes the rule of his faction), rename:@i:KEY (the new English name of his faction, from renames.tsv), target:@i:CITY:MONTHS, city_loss:CITY:PERCENT.
#   The other effects are the effects of the M9 events: join:@i:LOYALTY:MERIT, merit:@i:N, loyalty_all:N, order_all:N, morale_all:N, friendliness_with:@i:N.
# Venice gains public order in place of gold, because the M9 effects have no gold.
# E6 adds the sees. The effect see_holder:AUTHORITY:CHURCH gives the see a holder of another church, and a dash leaves it empty. The effect authority_seat:AUTHORITY:CITY moves the seat.
# The row caliph_to_cairo lists 15 owners of Baghdad, because a list holds 16 items. It leaves out Byzantium and the Abbasid faction.
